name: AutomationDirect KN-G12SP4 protective-earth terminal
summary: KN-G12SP4 protective-earth terminal arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: KN-G12SP4 is the drawing identifier for protective-earth terminal in AutomationDirect's Konnect-It DIN-Rail Terminal Blocks collection. A protective-earth terminal provides the specified connection to the protective bonding system. Its installation must follow the selected product and mounting arrangement.

For example, in a cabinet bonding row beside the field cable entries, use the KN-G12SP4 reference to coordinate earth conductor approach, mounting interface and identification. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Other PLC Products/Konnect-It/KN-G12SP4.DWG for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
